// Compiled only by the explicit local browser-walkthrough overlay, not routine
// tests. Both DBs, identities, HTTP servers and frontend are disposable.
package acceptance_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/slabarcaf/flowcard-treasury/services/browser-gateway/internal/config"
	"github.com/slabarcaf/flowcard-treasury/services/browser-gateway/internal/httpapi"
)

func TestOwnedBrowserWalkthrough(t *testing.T) {
	control := os.Getenv("BROWSER_GATEWAY_WALKTHROUGH_CONTROL")
	address := os.Getenv("BROWSER_GATEWAY_WALKTHROUGH_ADDRESS")
	if control == "" || address == "" {
		t.Fatal("explicit owned walkthrough control paths required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 12*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	authDB := owned(t)
	onboardingDB := owned(t)
	upstream := onboardingHarness(t, onboardingDB, 13*time.Minute)
	authDB.user(t, "ui.operator", "OPERATOR")
	authDB.user(t, "ui.customer", "CUSTOMER")
	cfg, err := config.Parse("127.0.0.1:0", authDB.runtimeURL, "http://127.0.0.1:5175", "true")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("walkthrough gateway config failed")
	}
	cfg, err = cfg.WithOnboarding(upstream, serviceSecret)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("walkthrough upstream config failed")
	}
	gateway := httptest.NewServer(httpapi.New(cfg, authDB.store))
	defer gateway.Close()
	root, err := filepath.Abs("../../../..")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	vite := exec.CommandContext(ctx, filepath.Join(root, "node_modules/.bin/vite"), "--config", "vite.browser-gateway.config.ts")
	vite.Dir = root
	vite.Env = append(os.Environ(), "VITE_BROWSER_GATEWAY_ENABLED=true", "BROWSER_GATEWAY_DEV_TARGET="+gateway.URL)
	vite.Stdout, vite.Stderr = io.Discard, io.Discard
	if err := vite.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("walkthrough frontend launch failed")
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- vite.Wait() }()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_ = vite.Process.Signal(os.Interrupt)
		select {
		case <-done:
		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
			cancel()
			<-done
		}
	})
	data, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"url": "http://127.0.0.1:5175", "gateway": gateway.URL, "operator": "ui.operator", "customer": "ui.customer"})
	if err := os.WriteFile(address, data, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("walkthrough readiness file failed")
	}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal("owned walkthrough deadline exceeded")
		case <-done:
			t.Fatal("walkthrough frontend exited early")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, err := os.Stat(control); os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Log("owned browser walkthrough stopped; disposing all owned resources")
				return
			}
		}
	}
}
